transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Nothing on the chain. Almost there.

transcript.speaker: LOYALIST
transcript.text: LOYALIST: Transmitting. Every second is a garrison.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Raiders inbound. Stay inside the volume.

transcript.speaker: LOYALIST
transcript.text: LOYALIST: Garrisons answering. Keep the volume.

transcript.speaker: LOYALIST
transcript.text: LOYALIST: Link lost! Kill the two jammer trucks on the farm road.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Second wave, riding harder. Seven, in two groups. Raiders in tow.

transcript.speaker: LOYALIST
transcript.text: LOYALIST: Two reply beacons lit. Follow them to check the garrisons.

transcript.speaker: LOYALIST
transcript.text: LOYALIST: West garrison beacon confirmed. East is ahead.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Scan both compounds for parked aircraft. Verify they stood down.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Engines cold at the first compound. Check the second.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: River gates keep you under the storm. Stay low.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Last gate. The marked tanks are just past it.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Rain hides the markings. Scan both ends before you fire.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Fuel markings visible. Keep the farm roofs out of the strike.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Three silos under the storm. Burn them.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Five diving through the cloud. Finish the tanks and turn.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Patrol riding the thunder. Five, in two groups.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Forward relay on the staging path. Cut it.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Hold over the relay. Its last traffic is still in the air.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Pair off the plateau, using the storm. Hold the orbit.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Second pair, coming out of the rain.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: One dish under the aurora. Cut it.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Four intercepts lit by the aurora, in pairs.

transcript.speaker: TEAL
transcript.text: TEAL (tape): If you hear this up here, read the signature.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: The archive is speaking. Signature decoding.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Archive lost. Jammer under the array. Find it, low.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Get under the aurora glow. It'll show on the scan.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: There. A dish truck in the array's shadow.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Jammer marked. Cut it.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Its escort is up. Two.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Archive's back. Hold the orbit. Read the signature.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Signature decoding. Hold. It carries a Marshal's seal.

transcript.speaker: VULTURE TWO
transcript.text: VULTURE TWO: Climb into my lights, trainee.

transcript.speaker: VULTURE TWO
transcript.text: VULTURE TWO: Teal climbed faster. Show me more.

transcript.speaker: MARINE
transcript.text: MARINE: Mark a clear pickup site. We need his answers alive.

transcript.speaker: MARINE
transcript.text: MARINE: Ridge landing zone clear. We can bring a helo there.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: His wingmen first. Four, in pairs.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: He flies like Teal. Teal learned it from him.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Chute open. His wing is turning back. Cover the marines' pickup.

transcript.speaker: MARINE
transcript.text: MARINE: We have him. Forty-five seconds to get him off the ridge.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: His second pair is diving on the pickup. Hold them.

transcript.speaker: MARINE
transcript.text: MARINE: Helo's spinning up. Almost out.

transcript.speaker: MARINE
transcript.text: MARINE: He is talking. Coast is recording. Hold the link.

transcript.speaker: MARINE
transcript.text: MARINE: He admits the handwriting. Coast is recording every word.

transcript.speaker: VULTURE TWO
transcript.text: VULTURE TWO: I taught him that turn. Wing, show the trainee the answer.

transcript.speaker: VULTURE TWO
transcript.text: VULTURE TWO: Last lesson. Wing, keep him busy.

transcript.speaker: VULTURE TWO
transcript.text: VULTURE TWO: Now. Again, trainee. From the top.

transcript.speaker: VULTURE TWO
transcript.text: VULTURE TWO: Head on. The way Teal never would.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: VULTURE TWO pulled back to call his wing. 1 inbound.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: VULTURE TWO pulled back to call his wing. 2 inbound.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Watch what the cranes unload. Mark the quays.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Those crates are munitions. The quays are military.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Three military quays. Hit the warehouses.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Early CAP pair launching. Finish the quay, then turn in.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Early pair off the apron. Clear them.

transcript.speaker: HARBOR
transcript.text: HARBOR: Follow the three quay beacons. Our launch needs a clear way out.

transcript.speaker: HARBOR
transcript.text: HARBOR: First bend clear. Last beacon marks the open channel.

transcript.speaker: HARBOR
transcript.text: HARBOR: Workers aboard. Cover our launch clear of the burning quays.

transcript.speaker: HARBOR
transcript.text: HARBOR: All workers counted. Past the worst of the smoke.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Main CAP off the apron. Four, in two groups.

transcript.speaker: HARBOR
transcript.text: HARBOR: Quays clear. Hold the channel while we count our people.

transcript.speaker: HARBOR
transcript.text: HARBOR: First crew answering. Still calling the eastern quay.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Full wing on the east line. Nine, in three groups.

transcript.speaker: MARINE
transcript.text: MARINE: Paper is aboard. Scan the harbor exit before we move.

transcript.speaker: MARINE
transcript.text: MARINE: Exit marked. We will move as soon as your scan is clear.

transcript.speaker: MARINE
transcript.text: MARINE: Launch moving. Keep the sky quiet.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Western wing reacting. Launch is halfway out.

transcript.speaker: MARINE
transcript.text: MARINE: Guns on both banks, firing on the launch! Silence them!

transcript.speaker: MARINE
transcript.text: MARINE: Holding at the exit. Mark the patrol boat's approach beacons.

transcript.speaker: MARINE
transcript.text: MARINE: Patrol boat sees your mark. One more beacon.

transcript.speaker: MARINE
transcript.text: MARINE: Patrol boat alongside. Hold until the paper changes hands.

transcript.speaker: MARINE
transcript.text: MARINE: Archive case passed. Tapes are next.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: The dark canal keeps you off his radar. Follow it.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Relay above the apartments. Hit only the dish.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Low scan over the canal. Mark the dish above the roofs.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Dish marked. Apartment roofs stay standing.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Broadcast relay above the city. Dish only.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Escort flight scrambling. Four, in two pairs.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Hold over the tower. I want to hear nothing from it.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Pair off the dark side of the city. Hold the orbit.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Still silent. Hold it.

transcript.speaker: HARBOR
transcript.text: HARBOR: Repair crew moving. Cover us to the dark district.

transcript.speaker: HARBOR
transcript.text: HARBOR: Crew passing the canal bend. Keep the approach clear.

transcript.speaker: HARBOR
transcript.text: HARBOR: Launch moored. Follow district lights to guide the shore crew.

transcript.speaker: HARBOR
transcript.text: HARBOR: Shore crew sees your mark. Moving to the next street.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: The fog depots carry his signature. Find them.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Permits match. Every depot is fuel.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Five depots in the fog. All marked.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Follow the pier beacons. Check the whole fuel line is cut.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: West pier empty. Follow the lights to the east.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Patrol riding the fog. Four, in two pairs.

transcript.speaker: HARBOR
transcript.text: HARBOR: Cannot see the piers. Cover us while we check the hoses.

transcript.speaker: HARBOR
transcript.text: HARBOR: Inspectors at the central pier. Fuel line looks dry.

transcript.speaker: HARBOR
transcript.text: HARBOR: Scan the last two piers. We need proof every hose is dry.

transcript.speaker: HARBOR
transcript.text: HARBOR: First hose disconnected. Check the eastern pier too.

transcript.speaker: HARBOR
transcript.text: HARBOR: Hoses dry. Hold the link for the frigates to copy.

transcript.speaker: FRIGATE
transcript.text: FRIGATE: Report copied. The escape fleet cannot refuel.

transcript.speaker: FRIGATE
transcript.text: FRIGATE: Ring closing. Raiders on the bow.

transcript.speaker: FRIGATE
transcript.text: FRIGATE: Second group off the platform. Hold them.

transcript.speaker: FRIGATE
transcript.text: FRIGATE: Third group, low on the water. Two left in the ring.

transcript.speaker: FRIGATE
transcript.text: FRIGATE: One gap open. Scan the water before we close the ring.

transcript.speaker: FRIGATE
transcript.text: FRIGATE: No wake in the gap. Finish the sweep.

transcript.speaker: FRIGATE
transcript.text: FRIGATE: Ring closed. Command flight launching. Four, from both sides.

transcript.speaker: FRIGATE
transcript.text: FRIGATE: Follow the outer beacons. Check the whole sea lane is in sight.

transcript.speaker: FRIGATE
transcript.text: FRIGATE: Western lane visible. Sweep to the eastern beacon.

transcript.speaker: FRIGATE
transcript.text: FRIGATE: Inspection launch crossing. Cover it until it docks.

transcript.speaker: FRIGATE
transcript.text: FRIGATE: Inspection launch halfway across. Gap remains clear.

transcript.speaker: FRIGATE
transcript.text: FRIGATE: No ships through. Hold the command link for the landing force.

transcript.speaker: LANDING CRAFT
transcript.text: LANDING FORCE: Ring report received. Bringing our boats forward.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Under the storm. Three gates to the platform.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Last gate. The deck stores are ahead.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Three stores on the deck. Burn them.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Patrol in the storm shadow. Five, in two groups.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Scan below the cloud. The tanker is hiding behind the deck smoke.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Engine heat below the cloud. It is running for the coast.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Tanker jet lifting off, running for the coast. Stop it.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Tanker's halfway to the coast. Close on it.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: He's almost over the city. Now!

transcript.speaker: FRIGATE
transcript.text: FRIGATE: Deck crew aboard. Cover them clear of the burning stores.

transcript.speaker: FRIGATE
transcript.text: FRIGATE: Launch halfway clear. Deck crew accounted for.

transcript.speaker: FRIGATE
transcript.text: FRIGATE: Tanker down. Hold while we check for other launches.

transcript.speaker: FRIGATE
transcript.text: FRIGATE: No second tanker on radar. Checking the last deck returns.

transcript.speaker: LANDING CRAFT
transcript.text: LANDING CRAFT: Beach in eighty seconds. Keep them off us.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Second intercept launching. Stay on the craft.

transcript.speaker: LANDING CRAFT
transcript.text: LANDING CRAFT: Surf line. Ramps going down.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: First intercept off the apron. Three, in two groups.

transcript.speaker: LANDING CRAFT
transcript.text: LANDING CRAFT: Ramps down. Scan both exits so we can leave the sand.

transcript.speaker: LANDING CRAFT
transcript.text: LANDING CRAFT: West exit clear. Check the eastern street.
